ResearchProjectDef.label: bonemold
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to grind bone and chitin and bind them with resin into bonemold, the light and durable armoring material of Morrowind. Bonemold can be made at a butcher table or a crafting spot.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Tamrielic smelting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to build a smelter and work the ores of Tamriel, from common iron and copper to ebony, malachite and adamantium.

ResearchProjectDef.label: alloying
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to blend metals the way Tamriel's smiths do: iron with corundum for steel, copper with tin for bronze and copper with zinc for brass.
